from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class OperatingCashFlowReport(BaseModel):
    """Operating cash flow figures extracted from a single company's financial filing."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the company that filed the report")
    current_period_label: str | None = Field(description="Description of the reporting period for the current amount (e.g., 'three months ended March 31, 2024')")
    current_period_amount: float | None = Field(description="Net cash provided by/used in operating activities for the current period")
    current_period_unit: str | None = Field(description="Unit scale of the amount as stated in the document, e.g., 'dollars' or 'thousands'")
    prior_period_label: str | None = Field(description="Description of the reporting period for the prior amount (e.g., 'three months ended March 31, 2023')")
    prior_period_amount: float | None = Field(description="Net cash provided by/used in operating activities for the prior period")
    prior_period_unit: str | None = Field(description="Unit scale of the amount as stated in the document, e.g., 'dollars' or 'thousands'")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    operating_cash_flow_reports: list[OperatingCashFlowReport]
